verses: Truly my soul waits for God; my salvation comes from him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I will not be greatly shaken.
How long will you attack a man to bring him down, all of you, like a leaning wall, a tottering fence?
They only plot to bring him down from his high position; they delight in lies. They bless with their mouths, but curse inwardly. Selah.
My soul, wait only for God; my hope comes from him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I will not be shaken.
My salvation and my glory are in God; my mighty rock and my refuge are in God.
Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
Surely people of low standing are a breath, and people of high standing are a lie; if weighed on the scales, together they are lighter than a breath.
Do not trust in extortion or put false hope in stolen goods; if riches increase, do not set your heart on them.
God has spoken once; I have heard it twice: that power belongs to God.
And to you, O Lord, belongs steadfast love; for you repay everyone according to what they have done.
